info.name: CivicFlow API
info.description:
CivicFlow — City Complaint & Service Request Platform Backend API Postman Collection.

### Platform Overview
Comprehensive REST API for municipal complaint lifecycle management, SLA monitoring, and paid municipal public service requests with Stripe payment processing.

### User Roles & RBAC Matrix
- **CITIZEN**: Can self-register, file complaints, view own complaints, confirm/close/reopen resolved complaints, leave 1-5 star ratings & feedback, request municipal services, and initiate Stripe checkout payments.
- **STAFF**: Assigned to municipal departments; can view assigned complaints, advance workflow to IN_PROGRESS, resolve complaints with notes, and track SLA turnaround deadlines.
- **ADMIN**: Full municipal system oversight; manages departments, categories with SLA hours, staff members, reviews/assigns complaints, monitors SLA breaches, views system-wide audit logs, and accesses analytics dashboards.

### Core Workflows
1. **Complaint Lifecycle**:
   `Citizen Submit` ➔ `Admin Review` ➔ `Staff Assign` ➔ `Staff In-Progress` ➔ `Staff Resolve` ➔ `Citizen Close` ➔ `Citizen Rating/Feedback`
2. **Paid Service & Stripe Payment**:
   `Citizen Request` ➔ `Stripe Checkout Session` ➔ `Payment via Stripe` ➔ `Cryptographic Stripe Webhook (checkout.session.completed)` ➔ `Payment Verified & Marked PAID` ➔ `Service Fulfillment`

request.description: [Public] Health check endpoint to verify backend service uptime and responsiveness.
[Public] Self-registration for citizens. Accounts are strictly defaulted to CITIZEN role.
[Public] Authenticates citizen user with email/password and automatically sets {{citizenToken}}.
[Public] Authenticates staff user with email/password and automatically sets {{staffToken}}.
[Public] Authenticates administrator user with email/password and automatically sets {{adminToken}}.
[Authenticated] Retrieves the authenticated user's profile details and role.
[Public] Explicitly logs out user session.
[Public] Retrieves Google OAuth 2.0 authorization URL in JSON format.
[Public] Authenticates or signs up citizen using Google OAuth ID token.
[Admin only] Creates a new municipal department and automatically saves {{departmentId}}.
[Public] Lists all active municipal departments.
[Public] Retrieves details of a specific department by ID.
[Admin only] Updates department name and description.
[Admin only] Toggles department active status.
[Admin only] Creates a complaint category with SLA turnaround hours and saves {{categoryId}}.
[Public] Lists all active categories and their assigned departments.
[Public] Retrieves details of a specific category.
[Admin only] Updates category name and SLA turnaround hours.
[Admin only] Toggles category active status.
[Admin only] Creates a new staff member linked to a department and saves {{staffId}}.
[Admin only] Lists all staff members across departments.
[Admin only] Lists staff members belonging to a specific department.
[Admin only] Retrieves profile of a specific staff member.
[Admin only] Updates staff name or transfers to another department.
[Admin only] Toggles staff active status.

request.description: [Citizen only] Lodges a municipal complaint with category & location; auto-calculates SLA dueAt and saves {{complaintId}}.
[Citizen only] Lists all complaints filed by the authenticated citizen.
[Admin only] Lists all municipal complaints across all departments and citizens.
[Staff only] Lists complaints currently assigned to the authenticated staff member.
[Authenticated] Retrieves full details of a complaint (owner citizen, assigned staff, or admin).
[Admin only] Reviews complaint and updates status to UNDER_REVIEW or REJECTED with note.
[Admin only] Assigns staff member to complaint (advances status to ASSIGNED).
[Staff only] Assigned staff updates status from ASSIGNED to IN_PROGRESS.
[Staff only] Assigned staff marks complaint as RESOLVED with resolution notes.
[Citizen only] Citizen confirms resolution and closes the complaint (advances status to CLOSED).
[Citizen only] Citizen reopens a resolved or closed complaint if issue persists.
[Citizen only] Citizen cancels own complaint before field work starts.
[Authenticated] Retrieves complete audit trail of status transitions and operator notes for complaint.
[Admin only] Retrieves aggregate SLA compliance summary (active, compliant, breached).
[Admin only] Lists all active complaints that have exceeded their SLA turnaround deadline.
[Staff only] Lists assigned active complaints ordered by closest approaching SLA due date.
[Admin only] Scans active complaints for SLA breaches and triggers automated notifications.
[Citizen only] Citizen submits 1-5 star rating and optional comments on resolved/closed complaint.
[Authenticated] Retrieves feedback submitted for a specific complaint.
[Citizen only] Citizen updates their previously submitted rating and review.
[Citizen only] Citizen deletes their submitted feedback.
[Admin only] Lists all citizen feedback and ratings across all complaints.
[Admin only] Creates a paid municipal public service in the catalog and saves {{serviceId}}.
[Public] Lists all active paid municipal public services.
[Public] Retrieves details and pricing of a specific municipal service.
[Admin only] Updates pricing or description of a municipal service.
[Admin only] Toggles service availability.
[Citizen only] Citizen submits a paid municipal service request and saves {{serviceRequestId}}.
[Citizen only] Lists all municipal service requests filed by authenticated citizen.
[Admin only] Lists all municipal service requests across citizens.
[Authenticated] Retrieves details of a specific service request (owner citizen or admin).
[Admin only] Updates service request operational status (PROCESSING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED).
[Citizen only] Creates a Stripe Checkout Session for a pending service request and returns the hosted Stripe payment URL.
[Authenticated] Retrieves payment transaction details and status (PENDING, PAID, FAILED) for a service request.
[Public / Stripe Gateway] Handles raw signed Stripe webhook events to verify signature and atomically mark payment as PAID.
[Authenticated] Retrieves notification list for authenticated user and saves first {{notificationId}}.
[Authenticated] Retrieves all unread notifications for authenticated user.
[Authenticated] Marks a specific notification as read.
[Authenticated] Batch marks all notifications of authenticated user as read.
[Admin only] Lists all system notifications across all users.
[Admin only] Retrieves system audit logs with optional filters (action, entity, userId).
[Admin only] Retrieves full chronological audit history for a specific entity ID.
[Admin only] Retrieves high-level citywide metrics, complaint volume, and resolution rates.
[Admin only] Department-level complaint volume, average resolution times, and SLA compliance.
[Admin only] Category-wise distribution and resolution statistics.
[Admin only] Staff-level workload, assigned tasks, and resolution performance.
[Admin only] Time-series complaint volume and metrics across specified date ranges.
[Admin only] Revenue analytics and request volume metrics for paid municipal services.
